tasks.title: Settle fixes: persist a --before-sha override on a repeat awaiting-review call; pin the incomplete guard's validation-status rule
tasks.description:
Two small fixes in src/settle.ts flagged by the round-15 reviews (#97, #94).

1. --before-sha ON A REPEAT CALL (#97). In `settleTask`'s early `record?.phase === 'awaiting-review'` branch, `const beforeSha = input.beforeSha ?? record.beforeSha` is used only to (re)write the review prompt file when it is missing, and is never saved. So a repeat `cairn round settle <id> --before-sha <sha>` leaves the record and prompt file naming the old range. Fix: when `input.beforeSha` is given and differs from `record.beforeSha`, save it to the record (short `store.update`, same as the first gate pass does with `r.beforeSha = beforeSha`) and REWRITE the review prompt file (unless `input.inlineReview`), even if the file already exists. With no override, or the same value, behavior is unchanged (rewrite only if missing).

2. INCOMPLETE GUARD (#94). The incomplete guard counts a task left `in-progress` at settle unless `validation.status === 'failed'`. That exclusion is only safe because `validateTaskTests` (src/test-validator.ts) returns `skipped` for any non-complete task and only produces `error` for complete tasks. Add a comment at the guard explaining this dependency, and a table-driven test in test/settle.test.ts over every `ValidationResult` status (`passed`, `failed`, `skipped`, `error`) combined with a re-read status of `in-progress`, pinning which ones increment `incompletes` today — so a future change to validateTaskTests or the guard fails a test instead of silently changing behavior.

TESTS (test/settle.test.ts): repeat awaiting-review call with a different --before-sha persists it and rewrites the existing prompt file with the new `<sha>..HEAD` range; same/absent override leaves an existing file untouched; the incomplete-guard status table.

TDD: write the failing test first, run it and watch it fail, then implement until it passes — all within this task.

LIVE-REPO HAZARD: never run `cairn round …`, `cairn hook …`, or `bun src/index.ts round|hook …` against this repository's root — a task in round 15 did, and left stale run state in .cairn/. Exercise these only through the tests, in temp directories created with fs.mkdtempSync.

TYPECHECK: `bun run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit over src/) must exit 0 when you finish.

PINNED BINARY (self-modifying round): do NOT modify cairn.json's healthCheck value and do NOT run ./install.sh. The user has pinned ~/.local/bin/cairn to a known-good build and redirected the health check to a throwaway outfile (/tmp/cairn-healthcheck). Running `bun run build` yourself is fine.

COMMIT: stage only the files you changed (never `git add -A` or `git add .`) — cairn.json has an uncommitted user change that must not be committed.
tasks.notes:
Settle fixes: --before-sha on a repeat awaiting-review call; incomplete guard pinned.

- src/settle.ts, awaiting-review short circuit: when `input.beforeSha` is given and differs from `record.beforeSha`, it is saved to the record (short `store.update`, only if the record still exists) and the review prompt file is rewritten even if it already exists (skipped under `inlineReview`). Same or absent override: unchanged (rewrite only if missing). settleTask doc comment updated.
- src/settle.ts, incomplete guard: comment explaining the dependency on validateTaskTests — 'skipped' for any non-complete task, 'error' only for an unreadable tasks.json or a test command that couldn't run on a complete task; only 'failed' reverts. Note: 'error' from an unreadable tasks.json can occur regardless of task status (the description said "only for complete tasks"; the comment states it precisely). src/test-validator.ts unchanged.
- test/settle.test.ts: review-phase tests for a different override (persisted + rewrite, later no-flag call keeps it and doesn't rewrite), same/absent override (no rewrite), inlineReview override (persisted, no file); a real-fs test (in the writeReviewPromptFile describe, temp dir) proving the existing file is rewritten with `sha-override..HEAD`; a test.each table over passed/failed/skipped/error × re-read in-progress pinning incompletes (passed/skipped/error → 1, failed → 0 and reverts 1) and the retry reason.
- TDD: 3 new review tests failed before the fix; the status table passed immediately (it pins current behavior by design).
- bun test: 1193 pass, 0 fail. bun run typecheck exits 0. cairn.json untouched.

tasks.title: Cleanups: shared CLI writer module; remove review.maxIterations from test fixtures
tasks.description:
Two small cleanups flagged by the round-15 reviews (#99, #107).

1. SHARED WRITERS (#99). The `Writer` type and `defaultStdout` / `defaultStderr` helpers are copy-pasted in src/commands/task.ts and src/commands/round.ts. Move them into a new shared module src/cli-io.ts and import them from both. Behavior must be identical (same output, same trailing-newline handling). If any test imports these from task.ts or round.ts, either re-export from the old module or update the import.

2. maxIterations FIXTURES (#107). `review.maxIterations` was deleted from the config in round 15 (CairnConfig.review is now `{ postTask: boolean }`), but fixtures still pass it: test/settle.test.ts (~line 81 `REVIEW_ON` and ~line 752 the review-disabled case) and test/commands/round.test.ts (~line 555 `makeConfig({ review: { postTask: true, maxIterations: 5 } })`). Remove the key from those `review` objects. Do NOT touch the unrelated `maxIterations` used for runRun's loop count / buildIterationPrompt (e.g. round.test.ts's 'maxIterations and totalRemaining are derived from the remaining work' test), and do not touch the legacy-key backward-compat tests in test/types.test.ts and test/config.test.ts, which intentionally keep it. Do not edit cairn.json.

TESTS: existing task/round/settle suites stay green; add a small test for src/cli-io.ts only if there's behavior worth pinning (writers append a newline, etc.).

TDD: where you add behavior, write the failing test first, run it and watch it fail, then implement — all within this task.

LIVE-REPO HAZARD: never run `cairn round …`, `cairn hook …`, or `bun src/index.ts round|hook …` against this repository's root. Exercise these only through the tests, in temp directories created with fs.mkdtempSync.

tasks.title: Docs: CLAUDE.md and README.md for the round-16 changes
tasks.description:
Update the repo-root CLAUDE.md and README.md for this round's changes. Read the landed code (src/settle.ts, src/run-state.ts, src/commands/round.ts, src/commands/hook.ts, package.json, tsconfig.json, commands/cairn-run.md) and document what is actually implemented.

1. Development section (CLAUDE.md, and README if it has an equivalent): add `bun run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit). State that it covers src/ only — test/ is not type-checked yet (it has ~43 pre-existing type errors, deferred to a later round) — and that `bun build --compile` and `bun test` do not type-check, so task `tests` arrays should include `bun run typecheck`.
2. CLAUDE.md 'Pin/unpin procedure for self-modifying rounds': add a rule that in a self-modifying round agents must never run `cairn round …` / `cairn hook …` (or `bun src/index.ts round|hook …`) against the project root — only in temp dirs — because round 15 left stale run state that way. Keep the rest of that section unchanged.
3. 'Two ways to run a round' / verdict list: `retry` verdicts now carry `promptFile` and `model` (and `next` names them), so the run agent never relies on remembered values for a relaunch.
4. 'Run state': picking a task records the pre-task sha under the lock (the first attempt's sha is kept on a re-pick); `cairn round next` prunes `executing` records whose task is no longer in tasks.json, never `awaiting-review` ones; settle's `already-settled` path clears a leftover executing record.
5. 'Enforcement under /cairn-run': the reviewer's Bash rule also denies git's `--output` / `--output=` option (it writes to a file). Record the remaining headless gap: `cairn run`'s reviewer uses `--allowedTools` prefix rules (`Bash(git diff:*)` etc.) that cannot exclude an argument, so a headless reviewer could still use `--output`; accepted as defense in depth since the reviewer follows its prompt.
6. README: the project-layout diagram labels `CLAUDE.local.md` '(gitignored — see Personal Agent Instructions)', but `cairn init` only WARNS when it isn't gitignored and never edits .gitignore. Reword the label accordingly.

Docs only — no source changes. Keep the existing tone and structure; don't restructure unrelated sections.

PINNED BINARY (self-modifying round): do NOT modify cairn.json's healthCheck value and do NOT run ./install.sh.

COMMIT: stage only CLAUDE.md and README.md (never `git add -A` or `git add .`) — cairn.json has an uncommitted user change that must not be committed.
